subject: general
question: Which new electricity trading tool did India propose in 2025 to help companies meet renewable energy targets?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Virtual Power Purchase Agreements (VPPAs)**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Virtual Power Purchase Agreements (VPPAs)** are innovative contracts that allow companies to purchase renewable energy virtually, without requiring a physical connection to a power source.
 
• They function as a type of financial agreement where a company agrees to pay a fixed price for energy generated by a renewable energy project.
 
• VPPAs help organizations meet their **renewable energy targets** by offsetting their carbon footprint and supporting clean energy initiatives.
 
• These agreements are particularly beneficial for companies operating in multiple locations as they provide flexibility and scalability across geographies.
 
• India's proposal of VPPAs in 2025 aims to encourage private sector participation in achieving **climate goals** and transitioning to cleaner energy sources.
 
• VPPAs contribute to the development of renewable energy projects by providing long-term financial security to developers.
 
• Such agreements are increasingly popular in industries striving to align with **sustainability standards** and corporate social responsibility goals.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Renewable Energy Certificates (RECs)**__

 __
 
• RECs are tradable instruments that represent proof that electricity was generated from a **renewable energy source**.
 
• They are commonly used to meet **regulatory requirements** or voluntary commitments to renewable energy use.
 
• While beneficial, RECs do not directly involve energy purchase agreements like VPPAs.
 
 
 
• **Green Energy Tariffs**__
 __
 
• These tariffs allow customers to purchase electricity from renewable sources through their utility provider.
 
• They are typically offered at a premium rate and are designed for customers seeking to support **sustainable energy production**.
 
• Unlike VPPAs, Green Energy Tariffs are more localized and do not involve complex financial agreements.
 
 
 
• **Time-of-Day Net Metering**__
 
 
• This mechanism allows users to adjust their electricity consumption based on **time-based pricing models**.
 
• It encourages energy use during off-peak hours to reduce costs and grid strain.
 
• While advantageous for energy management, it does not directly pertain to virtual energy contracts.
